verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents that Pulumi encrypts secret values in state or encrypts state files at rest. The closest items are generic mentions of 'secrets' as a concept (docs-29, docs-39), a 'secure' hosted backend (docs-23), and ESC secrets management/OIDC, which is an adjacent feature. None of these establish encryption of sensitive values within state files, so the story is unevidenced.
